scope: Visual review of HindLeftAnkleLayout-v001 only; no source/weight/rig/topology change or candidate.
command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 blender -b --factory-startup -noaudio --python tools/Render-MountAnatomyAtlas.py -- --profile <this folder>/profile.json --output <new folder>; python -I below-joint-analysis.py <folder>
findings: Outer crossing faces (135, magenta) form one continuous ring at the authored Z0.26 plane in all four isolated views; acceptable as a candidate OUTER boundary for further review only.
Protected core (blue) and old collar (orange) unchanged and visible; added band (yellow) correctly covers the visible ankle skin above the old low collar on outer/inner/back.

Plane growth also includes label-0 pendant/overlapping pieces: a rear tuft hanging to Z0.118 (component 62, 22 vertices, 82mm below joint) and a front ruffle of flaps lying over the hoof wall (several fragments, centroids Y-0.11..-0.145 from joint).
below-joint-band.json: 647 added-band vertices lie below the authored joint in 94 edge-connected fragments; most do not share a face with the core. These are not skin-transition evidence.
A grey hind.L fringe lobe (secondary label, excluded by allowed_semantic_labels) hangs outside the band in back/outer views, consistent with LabelCorrection-v001.
decision: Do not derive weights or a candidate from v001. Next: source-indexed ownership review of the below-joint fragments (feather/ruffle vs shell vs skin) and exclusion via reviewed labels, not a lower plane or width sweep.
limitations: Majority-vertex face colouring is display only.
Fragment split uses only edges among below-joint vertices; it is an inventory, not semantic segmentation.
Joint guides are projected along each view axis; authored coordinates in profile.
